z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c1: U-a, b, c bonke bayizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-18-01.title: Uma kukhona ama-equation amabili, isixazululo sihlala singamapheya oyedwa?
z-m-18-01.topic: Izinhlelo ze-linear equation ezingenaso isixazululo noma ezinezixazululo eziningi ngokungapheli
z-m-18-01.goal: Qinisekisa ngokuhlola isixazululo, ukuhlulela ulwazi, nezibonelo ozenza wena ukuthi uma kuhlanganiswa ama-linear equation amabili anezingaziwa ezimbili, isixazululo siwela emacaleni amathathu (ipheya eyodwa, ayikho, eziningi ngokungapheli), futhi uchaze ukuthi ngaphansi kwanoma yimuphi umbandela licala liphi livela.
z-m-18-01.material:
USoyoung wathi, "Uma kukhona ama-linear equation amabili anezingaziwa ezimbili u-x no-y, kuhlala kukhona ipheya eyodwa ngqo (x, y) enelisa omabili ama-equation ngasikhathi sinye." Lapha u-x no-y bangaba noma yiziphi izinombolo, futhi ama-equation wonke ayi-linear equation anama-coefficient ezinombolo eziphelele. USoyoung ufuna ukuhlola umcabango wakhe ngohlelo lwama-equation olungezansi. Indlela yokufunda: 'x ukwengeza u-2y kulingana no-6', '2x ukwengeza u-4y kulingana no-10'.
  ㉠ x + 2y = 6
  ㉡ 2x + 4y = 10
z-m-18-01.thinking.0: Ukuthola nokulungisa umugqa esixazululweni lapho isiphetho siphuma ngaphandle kwesisekelo
z-m-18-01.thinking.1: Ukuhlulela ukuthi yiluphi ulwazi olwengeziwe oludingekayo ukunquma inani lezixazululo
z-m-18-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza wena ama-equation amaningana anelisa izimo bese uwahlola
z-m-18-01.thinking.3: Ukuhlunga izimo lapho isitatimende se-'njalo' sisebenza khona
z-m-18-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi ukuthi isixazululo se-linear equation enezimiso ezimbili yipheya (x, y)
z-m-18-01.prereq.1: Incazelo yesixazululo sohlelo lwama-equation (ipheya elanelisa ama-equation womabili ngasikhathi sinye)
z-m-18-01.prereq.2: Isipiliyoni sokubona i-linear equation ax+by=c njengomugqa endizeni yokuxhumanisa (izinga leBanga 8; akudingeki wazi ubudlelwano nenani lezixazululo)
z-m-18-01.s.s1.prompt: Esixazululweni esingezansi, uSoyoung asibhale ngo-㉠ no-㉡, khetha umugqa owodwa lapho izizathu zokuthola isiphetho zishoda. Beka eceleni umcabango wokuqala (isitatimende sikaSoyoung) okwamanje bese uhlola umugqa ngomugqa ukuthi ama-equation ngempela asebenza yini.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-(0, 0)ohlangothini lwesobunxele lwe-equation ㉠, x + 2y = 6, bese uhlola ukuthi iba ngu-6 yini.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi emgqeni 2 u-2x + 4y ofanayo angalingana yini nezinombolo zombili u-12 no-10 ngasikhathi sinye.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.0: Ukuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ze-㉠ x + 2y = 6 ngo-2 kunika u-2x + 4y = 12.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.1: Ukuqhathanisa le equation no-㉡ 2x + 4y = 10, izinhlangothi zesobunxele ziyafana kodwa izinhlangothi zesokudla ziyahluka, u-12 no-10.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.2: Ngakho u-x no-y bobabili banyamalala, ngakho u-x = 0, y = 0 usixazululo.
z-m-18-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho isixazululo salolu hlelo lwama-equation yipheya eyodwa u-(0, 0).
z-m-18-01.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 awulandeli. Emgqeni 2 kwavela ukuthi u-2x + 4y ofanayo kumele abe ngu-12 futhi abe ngu-10, okusho ukuthi akunakwanelisa nganoma yimaphi amanani luka-x no-y. 'U-x no-y banyamalele' akusho 'u-x no-y bangu-0.' Uma ufaka u-(0, 0) ku-㉠, uthola u-0 = 6, okungasebenzi. Umugqa 4 siphetho esithatha iphutha lomugqa 3.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.prompt: Shiya ㉠ njengoba injalo bese ushintsha ㉡ ibe ngu-2x + 4y = c. (U-c ungaba yinombolo yanoma yiluphi, futhi asikayazi inani lawo. Indlela yokufunda: '2x plus 4y equals c') Ngalokho okwaziwa manje kuphela, ungasho ini ngesixazululo salolu hlelo lwama-equation?
z-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala i-equation oyithola ngokuphindaphinda izinhlangothi zombili ze-㉠ ngo-2 bese uyiqhathanisa eceleni nomumo we-㉡.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-12 nenombolo engesiyo u-12 ku-c, eyodwa ngayinye, bese uhlola ukuthi ama-equation amabili aba yisimo esifanayo yini.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.a: Noma u-c uyini, isixazululo sinqunywa njalo sibe yipheya eyodwa
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.a: Lokhu kuyinketho eyalethwa ngenkolelo yokuqala yokuthi ama-equation amabili asho ipheya eyodwa. Awuzange uhlole ukuthi uhlangothi lwesobunxele u-2x + 4y lungu-2 izikhathi ngolwe-㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.b: Noma u-c uyini, azikho u-x, y abanelisa ama-equation womabili
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.b: Umemezele 'ayikaze ihlangane' ubheke uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwe-㉡ kuphela. Awuzange ucabange ukuthi, kuye ngenani luka-c, ama-equation amabili angaba yi-equation efanayo yini.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.c: Sidinga ukwazi inani luka-c. Kuye ngo-c, akukho sixazululo noma kunezixazululo eziningi kakhulu
z-m-18-01.s.s2.o.d: Uma u-c engu-12 akukho sixazululo, futhi nganoma yimuphi omunye u-c kunezixazululo eziningi kakhulu
z-m-18-01.s.s2.r.d: Uthole amacala amabili kodwa ukuhlanganiswa kuphendukile. Zibhalele ukuthi ㉡ iba yi-equation efanayo ne-㉠ yini uma u-2x + 4y engu-12, u-2 izikhathi ezingu-6.
z-m-18-01.s.s2.explain: Uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwe-㉡, u-2x + 4y, lungu-2 izikhathi uhlangothi lwesobunxele lwe-㉠. Uma u-c = 12, ㉡ ingu-㉠ izinhlangothi zombili ziphindwe kabili, ngakho isimo siyafana futhi kunezixazululo eziningi kakhulu, futhi uma u-c engesiyo u-12, u-2x + 4y ofanayo kumele abe yinani elihlukile ku-12, u-2 izikhathi ezingu-6, ngakho akukho sixazululo. Kulolu hlelo lwama-equation, akukho nani luka-c lapho isixazululo siyipheya eyodwa ncamashi. Ngakho ukukhuluma ngenani lezixazululo, udinga inani luka-c.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.prompt: Manje klama uhlelo lwama-equation nge-㉠ x + 2y = 6 olungenaso isixazululo nhlobo. Bhala i-equation entsha njengo-ax + by = c, bese wenza ama-equation amabili ahlukile. (U-a, b, c bayizinombolo eziphelele, u-a no-b abasiyo u-0 futhi ngamunye unenani eliphelele elingu-20 ubuningi, futhi u-c unenani eliphelele elingu-100 ubuningi. 'ax + by = c' ifundwa 'a x plus b y equals c'.)
z-m-18-01.s.s3.hint.0: Khumbula ukuthi kwenzekani ku-s2 lapho u-c engeyona u-12, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ubudlelwano obunjani ama-coefficient luka-x no-y ayenabo ne-㉠ ngaleso sikhathi.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nquma u-a no-b kuqala, bese ushintsha u-c futhi uhlole eyodwa ngesikhathi ukuthi kukhona yini u-(x, y) owanelisa kokubili leyo equation ne-㉠. Kumele ushiye u-c owenza i-equation ifane ne-㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c1: U-a, b, c kumele babe yizinombolo eziphelele.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c2: U-a no-b akumele babe ngu-0 futhi kumele babe nenani eliphelele elingu-20 ubuningi, futhi u-c kumele abe nenani eliphelele elingu-100 ubuningi.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c3: Ama-coefficient luka-x no-y anesilinganiso esifanayo ne-㉠ (i-coefficient luka-y ingu-2 izikhathi i-coefficient luka-x).
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c3: Bheka ukuthi kukhona yini ubudlelwano obufanayo phakathi kwama-coefficient luka-x no-y njengakwi-㉠. Ngalo mumo, imigqa ihlangana endaweni eyodwa.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.ok.c4: Okungaguquki ohlangothini lwesokudla akuyona imiphindo efanayo nakwi-㉠ (akuyona i-equation efanayo).
z-m-18-01.s.s3.fail.c4: Le equation iba yi-equation efanayo ne-㉠, ngakho kunezixazululo eziningi kakhulu. Ukuze kungabikho sixazululo, okungaguquki ohlangothini lwesokudla kumele kuhluke.
z-m-18-01.s.s3.explain: Ngo-(a, b, c) = (1, 2, 5), u-x + 2y kumele abe ngu-6 futhi abe ngu-5, ngakho akukho sixazululo. U-(2, 4, 7) no-(-3, -6, -4) bayafana. U-(2, 4, 12) ungu-2 izikhathi ㉠, ngakho iyi-equation efanayo, futhi u-(1, 3, 4) unobudlelwano obuhlukile phakathi kwama-coefficient luka-x no-y, ngakho imigqa ihlangana endaweni eyodwa. Ama-equation amelela umugqa ofanayo, njengo-(2, 4, 7) no-(4, 8, 14), abalwa njengesisodwa.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.prompt: Phendula uSoyoung ngale ndlela. Isitatimende esithi 'Uma kunama-equation amabili, isixazululo sihlala siyipheya eyodwa ncamashi' silungile nini futhi siphosile nini? Bhala amacala lapho isixazululo siyipheya eyodwa, singekho, noma sinezixazululo eziningi kakhulu, uwaxhumanisa nomumo wama-equation (ama-coefficient okungaguquki ohlangothini lwesokudla).
z-m-18-01.s.s4.hint.0: Yenza amapheya ama-equation owenze ku-s2 nasku-s3 ne-㉠ eyodwa ngesikhathi, bese uqhathanisa ukuthi ama-coefficient okungaguquki ohlangothini lwesokudla ayizikhathi ezingaki ezinhlobonhlobo ze-㉠.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.hint.1: Wahlukanise abe amapheya angenaso isixazululo, amapheya anezixazululo eziningi kakhulu, namapheya anepheya eyodwa, bese ubhala ukuthi yini eyahluka ngalinye.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.placeholder: isb., Uma ama-coefficient luka-x no-y kuma-equation amabili ... , khona-ke ...
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ubhale ngokuhlukile ukuthi icala elingenaso isixazululo nelicala elinezixazululo eziningi kakhulu livela kumumo muni wama-equation?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ubhale nokuthi kuphuma nini ipheya eyodwa kuphela?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Unikeze izibonelo zezinombolo njengobufakazi, njenge-equation oyenze ku-s3 noma ㉠, ㉡?
z-m-18-01.s.s4.model.0: Isitatimende sikaSoyoung asihlali silungile. Uma isilinganiso sama-coefficient luka-x no-y siyahluka phakathi kwama-equation amabili, isixazululo siyipheya eyodwa. Uma isilinganiso sama-coefficient sifana kodwa isilinganiso sokungaguquki siyahluka, akukho sixazululo. Uma isilinganiso sokungaguquki sifana nasyo, iyi-equation efanayo, ngakho kunezixazululo eziningi kakhulu. Isibonelo, u-x+2y=6 no-2x+4y=10 abanaso isixazululo.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.model.1: Ungacabanga ngazo njengemigqa emibili. Uma ukuthambeka kuhlukile, ihlangana endaweni eyodwa, ngakho isixazululo siyipheya eyodwa. Uma ukuthambeka kufana futhi lapho idlula khona kuhlukile, iyafana futhi ayihlangani nhlobo, ngakho akukho sixazululo. Uma igqagqana ngokuphelele, kunezixazululo eziningi kakhulu. Ngakho ngoba nje kunama-equation amabili, akuhlali kuyipheya eyodwa.
z-m-18-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Impendulo evela embonweni wegrafu. Esikhundleni sokuyiveza ngama-coefficient nokungaguquki, yasho into efanayo isebenzisa ukuthambeka no-'lapho umugqa udlula khona.'
